steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "AI keys" [level=1]
  - paragraph: You don't need an AI key. Foundry matches your words to its list for free. A key lets an AI fill in the settings from your own words.
  - status:
    - paragraph: This computer has no keychain Foundry can use, so a key can't be saved.
    - paragraph: You can set INCEPTION_API_KEY in your own terminal before starting Foundry instead. Foundry never writes a key to a file.
  - heading "Inception (Mercury 3) Preview" [level=2]
  - text: Paste your Inception (Mercury 3) key
  - textbox "Paste your Inception (Mercury 3) key"
  - paragraph: Checking sends one request to the provider with your key. The key then goes into your keychain, and this page never sees it again.
  - button "Check and save" [disabled]
  - paragraph: Foundry stops using the key for the day once your daily limit is reached. You set the limit in Settings.
  - status
  - heading "Anthropic (Haiku 5.5) Planned" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Not available yet.
  - paragraph:
    - 'link "What you can do today: use the list, or Mercury"':
      - /url: "#/"
  - heading "OpenRouter Planned" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Not available yet.
  - paragraph:
    - 'link "What you can do today: use the list, or Mercury"':
      - /url: "#/"
